item.title: 🛠 Hit'em, our birds: drones of the 51st Army (the Tsentr Group of Forces) apply a modern drone to struggle with the enemy's ‘birds’
item.description: Hit'em, our birds: drones of the 51st Army (the Tsentr Group of Forces) apply a modern drone to struggle with the enemy's ‘birds’ 🛠 The main feature of the Sokol-I is a light weight, so it can be launched by hands without any launcher. The maximum altitude reaches 5,000 kilometres, and its maximum speed is up to 150 km/h. 💬 The UAV section leader with the call sign Vinni told about the combat use of the drone : ‘We take off as soon as any target appears, we begin to fly around searching it. We get locked on the target, in case if it's the enemy, we accompany and destroy it, let's say so. Also, we fly into the engine compartment from behind and explode, as well as we can land on or ram it and explode when we're already on the enemy. The most important thing is to see. If we see it, we destroy it anyway.’ 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 8 October 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1
)
💥
The Tsentr Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of
three mechanised brigades of the AFU, one marine brigade, and two national guard brigades close to Stepanovka, Belozerskoye, Sergeyevka, Roganskoye, Novoyavlenka, and Kamyshevakha (Donetsk People's Republic).
↗️
In Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Army were advancing in central and northern parts of the city.
Marine units continued the offensive in the south-western direction. They've established control over the sports centre, mopped up the stadium and the remaining part of the park area. Over the past 24 hours, 103 buildings have been liberated and more than 25 troops have been neutralised.
▪️
Ukrainian armed formations sustained losses of up to 535 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 12 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one radar station in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence.
They inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of two air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Orestopol, Velikomikhaylovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Krinovka, Mirovka, and Zalivnoye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 295 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, nine motor vehicles, and two artillery systems.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
They inflicted fire damage on two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine near Orekhov and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
More than 30 troops, 20 motor vehicles, a U.S.-made 155-mm M777 howitzer, and two electronic warfare stations have been neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian groups have inflicted fire damage on
production workshops of UAVs and their depots, artillery and missile ammunition depots, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 142 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
seven guided aerial bombs, one U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectile, and 1,062 fixed-wing UAVs.
⚓️
The Black Sea Fleet destroyed one uncrewed surface vehicle of the Ukrainian Navy in the Black Sea waters.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy
has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
256,490
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
31,159
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,785
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,659
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
73,965
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29916

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
Units of the Sever Group of Forces continue to tighten the encirclement and expand the external control zone in Kharkov region.
Battles are underway in the encirclement for the liberation of Nikolayevka, Varvarovka, Lukashovo, Reznikovo, Lobanovka, and Nefedovka (Kharkov region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 40 troops and a field artillery gun in the encirclement.
🚩
During the expansion of the external control zone, the Group's units established control over the settlement of Annopolye (Kharkov region).
In addition, Russian elements continue combat actions to establish control over the settlements of Prikolotnoye and Kotovka (Kharkov region).
💥
Also, in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of
one mechanised brigade, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade near Chernoglazovka, Mishchenki, Dergachi, Velikiy Burluk, Artemovka, and Novy Burluk.
🔥
In Sumy region, strikes were delivered at
formations of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade near Kiyanitsa, Grunovka and Sumy.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost up to 280 troops, 19 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and three electronic warfare stations in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group's units improved the situation along the front line
and inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Maliyevka, Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region), Volchiy Yar, Karpovka, and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 210 troops, a UK-made Snatch armoured fighting vehicle, a U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS launcher, a Gvozdika self-propelled artillery system, 12 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
They inflicted fire damage on two mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade near Krasny Molochar, Belenkoye, Kramatorsk, Gavrilovka, Nikolayevka, and Semenovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 160 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 34 motor vehicles, and a counter-fire radar.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29911

Ready to perform tasks
▫️
🚀
In accordance with the Strategic Missile Forces 2026 training plan, the Strategic Missile Forces Command Commission conducts
a comprehensive inspection of the Strategic Missile Forces formation headquartered in Vladimir
including a command post exercise with a silo-based missile formation led by the Strategic Missile Forces Commander
Colonel General Sergei Karakayev.
📑
The Strategic Missile Forces Command Commission will assess the combat training level of the command, control bodies, and crews. In addition, support forces (with deployment in the assigned areas) as well as assigned units of the Moscow Military District were involved in the practical tasks performance.
🔥
In addition to a silo-based rocket formation,
autonomous rocket launchers of mobile-based missile formations of the Strategic Missile Forces were deployed
on combat patrolling routes.
▫️
During the exercise,
the Yars transporter erector launcher crews
train to perform marches, missile divisions dispersion including field positions change, overcoming contaminated areas, use of engineering equipment, as well as camouflage and security organisation.
🎮
The Army aviation and the Strategic Missile Forces' UAV units
are used to reconnoitre the routes of hardware, to search and detect mock saboteurs.
🔹
The main purpose of the exercise is
to improve the coherence of military command and control bodies.
⬆️
During the inspection, the formation's personnel demonstrate
a high level of combat training and readiness to perform tasks according to their purpose.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
